tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250snyan brgyud rta mchog rol pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300bde ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// longs spyod yongs rdzogs dbang chen rta mchog dpal// grub pa'i rig 'dzin nā gardzu na la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung mthar byed shog /snang srid dbang bsgyur padma rgyal po dang*// snyan brgyud bka' babs padma mdo sngags gling*// chos bdag skyes mchog brgyud par bcas pa la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung mthar byed shog /yi dam dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag sogs// padma gsung gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung mthar byed shog /gzhi yi rigs sad lam gyi bgrod pa yis// snang srid thams cad gdon nas dag par shar// rta skad thengs gsum dgongs pa mngon gyur nas// 'bras bu rta mchog rol pa mngon gyur shog /

ces pa'ang 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros pas gsol ba btab pa siddhi rastu/ ༈ /dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
